historical_review.patch_status: Original defective patch preserved separately; not applied to this work branch.
known_defects: Publication read scope survives generator yield and leaks stale physical-read verdicts.
Prepared request reuse can mix an old request with fresh prepared members.
Native identity hashes the wheel wrapper instead of its inner loaded extension.
Historical adaptive/exact hints can suppress an available current EXACT_MEMORY route.
Native test assumes an installed kernel is selected despite the Unicode compatibility fallback.
historical_review.separate_experiment: Rejected separately: oracle implementation changes can reuse stale verification; patch writes can follow symlinks outside the repository. This experiment is not the production ADAPT patch.

test_evidence.ordinary_canonical_cycle: Passed on the old patched base: one provider call, fresh C1/oracle, no agent execution at reuse, identical same-version resume, restored source.

historical_review.timing_scope: One ordinary run, four library entries, native enabled, local test provider. External LLM latency excluded. Separate profiler timing is not ordinary latency.
historical_review.limits: Known defects prevent acceptance despite passing tests. These results do not certify the new base or its replacement oracle.

implementation_order: Port the canonical diagnostic harness to the current change oracle and establish a fresh baseline.
Port relevant ADAPT and optimization changes with regression tests for the known defects; do not blindly apply the cumulative archive patch.
Keep publication reads fresh and derive request and members from the same checked read.
Fix native wheel identity while preserving Unicode fallback.
Separate current EXACT_MEMORY eligibility from historical adaptive ambiguity.
Make IR validation and emission one operation; reuse the checked core payload within one unit validation.
Replace the Python surrogate scan with an equivalent compiled regex while preserving refusal behavior.
Optimize repeated pure library and lineage reconstruction while retaining physical, lifecycle and authority checks.
Combine recovery verification only after proving consistency and lifetime of all physical evidence.
acceptance_requirements: Preserve canonical bytes, content keys and context hashes.
Preserve forgery detection, mutable isolation, corruption/quarantine behavior and refusal ordering.
Test deletion/substitution between reads, suspended generators, same-size/same-mtime changes and lifecycle revocation.
Test current exact conflicts and exact eligibility with multiple historical revisions.
Use a real installed wheel to verify native identity and frozen-runtime drift.
Run canonical learn/approve/reuse/approve/resume with fresh C1/oracle and validate replay.
Same-version resume remains valid; source/runtime changes must change runtime identity.
Benchmark ordinary wall/CPU separately from profiling against the corrected baseline.
current_change_scope: Development checkpoint only; executable product code unchanged from base_commit.
mutation_check: Not applicable: documentation-only checkpoint; no executable behavior changed.
